milestones.title: M1 Open MVP
milestones.description: Registry, RFQ, control tower and gap finder live on public data; CI and guard green.

epic.title: [TPM] Epic: Canada Space Turbopump Supply Chain Marketplace
epic.body:
Open-tier marketplace for the 41-part small liquid-rocket turbopump: supplier registry, RFQ matchmaking, control-tower view, gap and investment finder. Dashboard UX. Clean-room interop: third-party platform SDKs as out-of-repo plugins, data platforms as an import/export mapping only

Sub-tasks are linked below by the bootstrap script. Weekly digest posts here every Monday.

issues.title: Land module skeleton, data, tests and CI
issues.body:
Merge the initial PR: data (41 parts, 28 entities, public sources), registry/RFQ/gaps/engine/interop code, 11 tests, OpenAPI contract, CI and guard.

- [ ] CI green
- [ ] Guard green with GUARD_TERMS secret set
- [ ] TRM approves (red zone: workflows)

issues.title: Set GUARD_TERMS secret and PROJECT_TOKEN for automation
issues.body: TRM only. Add repository secrets: GUARD_TERMS (restricted terms, one per line), PROJECT_TOKEN (fine-grained PAT, org Projects read/write). Add variable TPM_PROJECT_URL.

issues.title: Resolve two ownership conflicts (Burloak parent, Magellan ownership)
issues.body:
Two sources disagree on each. Find primary sources (corporate filings, GLEIF Level 2, ISED Federal Corporations). Update entities.json with grade 'confirmed' or keep 'reported' with a note.

- [ ] Each change cites an https primary source

issues.title: Supplier self-registration flow with evidence upload
issues.body:
Port the existing seller registration pattern: company, ownership, parts offered, sources. New records land as 'reported', never 'confirmed', until reviewed.

- [ ] Validation mirrors the RFQ rules (no technical data)
- [ ] Review queue for TRM

issues.title: ISED Federal Corporations adapter for supplier identity
issues.body:
Open Government Licence - Canada. Match entities to corporation numbers. New data feed = red zone.

- [ ] Licence file in adapter folder
- [ ] Drops personal fields (directors) by default

issues.title: GLEIF Level 2 adapter for ultimate-parent checks
issues.body:
Flags foreign control automatically. Feeds the ownership_class field with a source.

- [ ] Cache and rate limits
- [ ] Tests with recorded fixtures, no live calls in CI

issues.title: CanadaBuys award adapter: who already sells to DND and CSA
issues.body:
OGL-Canada; keep organisations only, drop named contacts.

- [ ] Adds 'prior federal awards' fact to supplier profile

issues.title: RFQ persistence and supplier responses (interested / no-bid / quote offline)
issues.body:
Implement POST /rfqs and /rfqs/{id}/quotes from the OpenAPI contract. Prices and technical data stay off-platform.

- [ ] Audit log of every state change

issues.title: RFQ notifications to matched suppliers (opt-in)
issues.body: Email only to suppliers who registered and opted in. Sends messages = red zone.

issues.title: Controlled Goods Program check on export-listed lines
issues.body: For ECL 6-3 lines, require the supplier to attest CGP registration before seeing the RFQ. Counsel review of wording.

issues.title: Control-tower dashboard v1
issues.body:
Coverage bar, ownership mix, export-listed count, BOM tree, entity drawer. Facts-only; engine panel shows 'connect engine' state.

- [ ] Works at phone width
- [ ] Light and dark
- [ ] WCAG 2.1 AA contrast

issues.title: Engine port: connect private assessment engine in staging
issues.body:
Deploy-time TPM_ENGINE_MODULE pointing at the private core. Nothing from the private core enters this repo.

- [ ] Contract test: engine output matches the Assessment typedef

issues.title: Gap finder v1: build vs domesticate pathways
issues.body:
25 gaps today (8 no candidate, 17 no Canadian-owned). Group by assembly as project candidates.

- [ ] Sources shown for every gap

issues.title: Investment one-pagers per gap project (unsized, open tier)
issues.body: Generate a one-page brief per project: what is missing, who supplies it abroad, pathway. Sizing comes from the private engine later.

issues.title: Supplier interviews: 8 unsourced parts
issues.body: Dynamic seals, titanium billet, ceramic ball blanks, stainless and bearing steels, igniter, instrumentation, fasteners, static seals. Human work; results update parts.json.

issues.title: Third-party platform plugin repo (out of tree) after sandbox approval
issues.body:
the third party licence bars redistribution, so the plugin lives in a separate private repo and loads through TPM_INTEROP_PLUGINS.

- [ ] Developer-programme approval
- [ ] Plugin consumes only the labelled open bundle

issues.title: data-platform import/export mapping document
issues.body: Design-only: map our CSV tables to object types and links. No third party code. Comparable, never template.

issues.title: CCO ontology alignment file for registry types
issues.body: Align Part, Entity, Ownership to Common Core Ontologies (BSD-3). Alignment file only.

issues.title: Authentication, roles and rate limits for the API
issues.body:
Roles: buyer, supplier, reviewer, admin. Bearer tokens, short expiry, per-role rate limits.

- [ ] OWASP ASVS L2 checklist

issues.title: Threat model (STRIDE) and red-team pass 1
issues.body:
Focus: data poisoning of supplier records, RFQ scraping for competitive intel, technical-data leakage, supply-chain attack on CI.

- [ ] Findings filed as issues

issues.title: Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs and enable Dependabot
issues.body: Supply-chain hardening for CI. Dependency pins = red zone.

issues.title: Red-team pass 2 before engine connection
issues.body: Independent reviewer. Includes the engine port and plugin loader (dynamic import paths).

issues.title: Accessibility and mobile audit of the dashboard
issues.body: WCAG 2.1 AA, keyboard paths through every tab, 360px width.

issues.title: Weekly digest and board automation live
issues.body: After secrets are set, run the project-automation workflow once by hand and confirm the epic comment appears.
